# Growth Audit

## Purpose
Assess the state of the Growth department in the whole system: how well acquisition, conversion, retention, distribution, analytics, and messaging hold together, and where they are weak.

## Scope
- Acquisition and demand
- Conversion
- Retention
- Distribution
- Analytics
- Messaging and positioning

## What is in place
- [ ] Lead agent for growth is named and active
- [ ] Skill that audits search visibility
- [ ] Skill that writes copy in the product voice
- [ ] Skill that plans content
- [ ] Skill that applies messaging psychology
- [ ] Skill that tracks analytics end to end
- [ ] Workflow that carries a launch from plan to distribution

## Gaps
- [ ] Acquisition is scattered tactics, not a system
- [ ] Conversion has no measured funnel
- [ ] Retention and churn have no owner
- [ ] Content is produced in bursts, then stops
- [ ] Analytics exist but nobody reads them before deciding
- [ ] Messaging differs across channels

## Next steps
- Pick the highest priority gap and name its owner
- Add or fix the missing agent, skill, command, or workflow for that gap
- Run the new piece on a real launch or campaign and check the result against evidence
- Record the decision and the outcome in the decision log
- Repeat for the next gap
- Share the finished audit and the changes with the people who need them, so the work reaches distribution
